source.quote: Based on our current projections for continued growth in the fourth quarter, we expect full year revenue to increase approximately 30% over 2025 at the mid-point.
For 2026, we continue to expect the tax rate for the full year to remain at approximately 18% plus or minus 3%.
For the fourth quarter, we expect revenue to increase to approximately $550 million, plus or minus 3%.
Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to expand to 37% plus or minus 1%.
Non-GAAP adjusted EPS is expected to be $1.35 plus or minus $0.10.
Capital expenditures on a cash basis were $53.2 million for the third quarter or 10% of revenue, which is above our targeted annualized range of 5% to 9% of revenue.
